name: Juan Iglesias Fernández
title: Engineering Leader | Senior Engineering Manager | Head of Engineering
summary: Engineering leader with 8+ years of experience in software engineering and engineering management, including Senior Engineering Manager / Head of Engineering responsibilities across multi-team organizations. Strong focus on building high-performing teams, creating structure in fast-moving environments, improving delivery predictability, and aligning engineering execution with product and business strategy. Experienced in managing managers, coaching Staff and Principal engineers, scaling engineering practices, defining roadmaps and capacity plans, and partnering closely with Product, Marketing, Customer Success, Security, and executive stakeholders. Background in mobile, backend, microservices, cloud-native systems, and large-scale marketplace products.

values.title: 🤝 Collaboration
values.description: No matter how good you are individually, you always need a team around you. I optimize for shared context, clear communication, and strong collaboration across roles to succeed together.

values.title: 👑 Ownership
values.description: I treat the things I do as my own. That mindset helps me deliver higher quality, follow through, and continuously improve what we build and how we build it.

values.title: 🌟 Optimism
values.description: I work better when I'm happy. If I spend 8 hours a day with a team, I want to enjoy the journey while bringing real value to the company, and creating impact makes me even happier.

values.title: 👥 People first
values.description: AI works for us, but people are still the most important part of our teams. Empathy and care help people grow, and teams grow stronger when we invest in humans first.
